about: Modwerk source-only envelopes package for Analog Rytm MKII OS 1.74, compiled from sdk/analog-rytm-mkii/modules/envelopes.

mods.title: Improved Envelopes
mods.summary: The AMP envelope reworked: HOLD runs from no hold to AUTO, ATK, HOLD and DEC/REL have fine steps from 0.2 ms, ENV RESET gains AMP, and the envelope knobs show times.
mods.description: The AMP envelope reworked: HOLD runs from no hold to AUTO, ATK, HOLD and DEC/REL have fine steps from 0.2 ms, ENV RESET gains AMP, and the envelope knobs show times.
mods.author: npp1993
mods.on_unit: This source ran on the author's Analog Rytm MKII on OS 1.74 in a 16-module combined image (ED02, measured over USB: AMP DEC, AMP HLD, FILTER DEC and REL); this package has not run alone on a unit.
